acceptance_criteria.description: Upload, finalize defense-in-depth, and restore reject structurally valid but offline-ineligible, registry-invalid, or badge-invalid character saves without advancing canonical head state.
Revision 1 requires generation 1; later normal finalizes require exact wrapping increment and exact bound lineage; replay remains idempotent.
A verified historical restore may reset generation to its source, preserves the same bound lineage, and the next normal finalize advances from that restored generation.
Durable plus active prepared declared bytes never exceed the per-character quota, including concurrent preparation and maximum-size resume declarations.
Post-put ticket expiry/conflict and expired prepared cleanup leave no untracked object created by that attempt, while exact retries and finalized objects remain intact.
Server library, HTTP smoke, strict clippy, package formatting, and owned-path diff checks pass with adversarial regression tests.

closed_decisions: Every nonzero snapshot must parse as an online-eligible CSP1 save under the compiled registry contract; migration-ambiguous saves, unassigned identity bits, and unassigned regional badges are rejected at upload, finalize, and restore boundaries.

The first committed snapshot must carry save_generation 1 and binds the server-side lineage to the selected SaveBlock2 player identity. This detects cross-character replacement after first commit but is not claimed to prevent a malicious clone at the first upload.

A normal finalize after revision 1 must preserve the bound character lineage and advance save_generation by exactly one with u32 wrapping semantics. Server-authorized restore may move generation back to a verified historical source and makes that source the new head for the next increment.

This phase validates container, registry, lineage, and generation continuity. Full authorization of every story/trainer/gym/event progression addition remains owned by the later gameplay commit ledger and must not be falsely claimed here.

Per-character storage quota includes durable snapshot declarations and all active prepared declarations. Object writes created by a losing or expired upload attempt are conditionally deleted without deleting pre-existing immutable objects.

Expired prepared objects are collected only from server-derived keys after authentication/fencing and are never confused with finalized snapshot objects. Local in-memory cleanup is synchronous; production background garbage collection remains a separate adapter requirement.
forbidden_changes: Do not edit coop-save, cloud/protocol/launcher/sidecar/ROM/Lua code, Cargo manifests or lockfiles, documentation outside this worker contract, or orchestration state.
Do not weaken authentication, lease fences, parent-revision checks, immutable object checks, exact artifact sizes, digest checks, idempotency, or restore provenance.
Do not claim client CRC as authorization for progression additions or invent a gameplay commit ledger in the snapshot service.
Do not delete an object that predated the current conditional put, belongs to a finalized snapshot, or has a different server-derived character/snapshot/artifact key.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, or overwrite edits from other active workers.
objective: Harden the local Phase 2 snapshot service around validated online saves, per-character revision lineage and generation continuity, bounded prepared-upload storage, and race-safe orphan cleanup.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and required verification has recorded outcomes.
A safe lineage/generation transition requires a frozen save or wire ABI change outside owned files.
A concrete build, adapter, or shared-worktree conflict prevents further progress within the owned files and budget.
